phrases.arabic: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى دِمَشْقَ الْقَدِيمَة
phrases.transliteration: min fadlika, ureedu adh-dhahaaba ilaa Dimashqa al-qadeema

phrases.arabic: هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تُوصِلَنِي إِلَى بَابِ تُومَا؟
phrases.transliteration: hal tastatee3u an tuwsilanee ilaa baabi Toomaa?

phrases.arabic: هَلْ تُوجَدُ سَيَّارَة أُجْرَة قَرِيبَة مِنْ هُنَا؟
phrases.transliteration: hal toojadu sayyaara ujra qareeba min hunaa?

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، هَلْ تُوجَدُ سَيَّارَة أُجْرَة قَرِيبَة مِنْ هُنَا؟
dialogue.transliteration: law samahta, hal toojadu sayyaara ujra qareeba min hunaa?
dialogue.english: Excuse me, is there a taxi nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: Yes, there is one at the traffic light.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: سَيَّارَة أُجْرَة! مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى دِمَشْقَ الْقَدِيمَة.
dialogue.transliteration: sayyaarat ujra! min fadlika, ureedu adh-dhahaaba ilaa Dimashqa al-qadeema.
dialogue.english: Taxi! Please, I want to go to Old Damascus.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Go ahead, get in.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تُوصِلَنِي إِلَى بَابِ تُومَا؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal tastatee3u an tuwsilanee ilaa baabi Toomaa?
dialogue.english: Can you take me to Bab Touma?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Of course. We will arrive within ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Turn on the meter please.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Certainly, the meter is running.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: اِسْتَمِرَّ إِلَى نِهَايَةِ الشَّارِع، ثُمَّ اِبْقَ عَلَى الْيَمِين.
dialogue.transliteration: istamirra ilaa nihaayati ash-shaari3, thumma ibqa 3alaa al-yameen.
dialogue.english: Go straight to the end of the street, then keep to the right.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Fine. Here?

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، هُنَا جَيِّد، تَوَقَّفْ. كَمِ الْأُجْرَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, hunaa jayyid, tawaqqaf. kami al-ujra?
dialogue.english: Yes, here is fine, stop. How much is the fare?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: One thousand five hundred pounds.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Here you are, and keep the change.

pair.english: Where do you want to go?

response.english: I want to go to Bab Touma.

pair.english: How much is the fare to here?

lessons.culture: Taxis in Fusha-speaking cities are hailed with a raised hand and the destination is stated before you get in. Agree on the meter or the price first, and round the fare up with الْبَاقِي لَكَ if the ride was good.

exercises.prompt: You get in a taxi and the driver asks where to. Say you want to go to Old Damascus.
exercises.tip: أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى means 'I want to go to'.

exercises.prompt: The driver says: 'وَصَلْنَا. أَلْف لِيرَة.' Pay and tell him to keep the change.
exercises.tip: الْبَاقِي is 'the rest', the change.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'شَغِّلِ _____، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.' (Turn on the meter please.)
exercises.tip: الْعَدَّاد is the taxi meter.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'اِسْتَمِرَّ إِلَى _____ الشَّارِع.' (Go straight to the end of the street.)
exercises.tip: نِهَايَة means 'end'.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Stop right here.'
exercises.tip: قِفْ is the command 'stop' to one person.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'How much is the fare to here?'
exercises.tip: الْأُجْرَة is the fare.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'Keep to your right.'?
exercises.tip: الْيَمِين is right and الْيَسَار is left.

exercises.prompt: You have no small money. What do you say?
exercises.tip: لَيْسَ مَعِي means 'I do not have with me'.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، / الْعَدَّاد، / شَغِّلِ'.
exercises.tip: The command comes first and the polite ending last.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'هُنَا / تَوَقَّفْ / جَيِّد،'.
exercises.tip: Say where, say it is fine, then tell him to stop.

phrases.arabic: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَصِلُ إِلَى الْجَامِعِ الْأُمَوِيّ؟
phrases.transliteration: min ayna asilu ilaa al-jaami3i al-umawee?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.arabic: إِلَى الْأَمَامِ مُبَاشَرَة، ثُمَّ اِنْعَطِفْ يَمِينًا عِنْدَ الْإِشَارَة.
dialogue.transliteration: ilaa al-amaami mubaashara, thumma in3atif yameenan 3inda al-ishaara.
dialogue.english: Straight ahead, then turn right at the traffic light.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Is it far or near?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.arabic: قَرِيبَة. خَمْسُ دَقَائِق سَيْرًا عَلَى الْأَقْدَام.
dialogue.english: Near. Five minutes on foot.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا. وَأَنَا أَيْضًا أَبْحَثُ عَنِ الْجَامِعِ الْأُمَوِيّ.
dialogue.transliteration: shukran jazeelan. wa anaa aydan abhathu 3ani al-jaami3i al-umawee.
dialogue.english: Thanks a lot. I am also looking for the Umayyad Mosque.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَصِلُ إِلَى الْجَامِعِ الْأُمَوِيّ؟
dialogue.transliteration: min ayna asilu ilaa al-jaami3i al-umawee?
dialogue.english: From where do I get to the Umayyad Mosque?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: Walk straight until the end of the market.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: And after that?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.arabic: اِنْعَطِفْ يَسَارًا بَعْدَ الْمَسْجِد. أَوَّلُ زُقَاق عَلَى يَمِينِكَ.
dialogue.transliteration: in3atif yasaaran ba3da al-masjid. awwalu zuqaaq 3alaa yameenika.
dialogue.english: Turn left after the mosque. The first alley is on your right.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Okay. But this street is closed.

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.arabic: آسِف. إِذَنْ اِمْشِ مِنَ الطَّرِيقِ الْآخَر.
dialogue.transliteration: aasif. idhan imshi mina at-tareeqi al-aakhar.
dialogue.english: Sorry. Then walk by the other road.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا تَائِه، هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ مُسَاعَدَتِي؟ شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا.
dialogue.transliteration: anaa taa2ih, hal yumkinuka musaa3adatee? shukran jazeelan.
dialogue.english: I'm lost, can you help me? Thanks a lot.

pair.english: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?
I'm lost, can you help me?

response.arabic: طَبْعًا، إِلَى أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَذْهَب؟
response.transliteration: tab3an, ilaa ayna tureedu an tadh-hab?
response.english: Of course, where do you want to go?

lessons.culture: Strangers in Arabic-speaking cities will gladly stop to give directions, and often walk with you part of the way. Landmarks such as a mosque, a traffic light or the market are used more than street names.

exercises.prompt: You stop a passer-by. Ask where the pharmacy is.
exercises.tip: Open with لَوْ سَمَحْتَ, then the question word أَيْنَ.

exercises.prompt: A stranger says: 'شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا'. Reply politely.
exercises.tip: عَفْوًا answers thanks; the longer form means 'no thanks for a duty'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'اِنْعَطِفْ _____ عِنْدَ الْإِشَارَة.' (Turn right at the traffic light.)
exercises.tip: يَمِينًا is 'to the right'; يَسَارًا is 'to the left'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'هَلْ هُوَ بَعِيد _____ قَرِيب؟' (Is it far or near?)
exercises.tip: أَمْ means 'or' between two choices in a question.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'This street is closed.'
exercises.tip: مُغْلَق means 'closed'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'How far is it from here?'
exercises.tip: يَبْعُدُ means 'it is distant'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'Straight ahead.'?
exercises.tip: الْأَمَام is 'the front'.

exercises.prompt: You are lost. What do you say?
exercises.tip: A woman says تَائِهَة for 'lost'.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'الْمَسْجِد / يَسَارًا / اِنْعَطِفْ / بَعْدَ'.
exercises.tip: Verb, direction, then the landmark.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'السُّوق / اِمْشِ / نِهَايَةِ / حَتَّى'.
exercises.tip: حَتَّى means 'until'.

phrases.arabic: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
phrases.transliteration: hal tadh-habu haadhihi al-7aafila ilaa al-Mazza?

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: Over there, in front of the bank.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: What's the bus number to the university?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.arabic: الرَّقْمُ اثْنَا عَشَر. تَأْتِي كُلَّ فَتْرَة قَصِيرَة.
dialogue.transliteration: ar-raqmu ithnaa 3ashar. ta2tee kulla fatra qaseera.
dialogue.english: Number twelve. It comes every little while.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal tadh-habu haadhihi al-7aafila ilaa al-Mazza?
dialogue.english: Does this bus go to Mazzeh?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes, get on.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: How much is the fare?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: One hundred pounds.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: خُذِ الْبَاقِي، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. الْحَافِلَة مُزْدَحِمَة جِدًّا.
dialogue.transliteration: khudhi al-baaqee, min fadlika. al-7aafila muzda7ima jiddan.
dialogue.english: Take the change please. The bus is very crowded.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، الْحَافِلَة التَّالِيَة أَقَلُّ زِحَامًا، أَفْضَل.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, al-7aafila at-taaliya aqallu zi7aaman, afdal.
dialogue.english: Yes, the next bus is emptier, better.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Is there an empty seat?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، فِي الْخَلْف. هَلْ تَتَوَقَّفُ عِنْدَ دَوَّارِ الْحَلْبُونِيّ؟ نَعَمْ، أَنْزِلْنِي هُنَاك.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, fee al-khalf. hal tatawaqqafu 3inda dawwaari al-7alboonee? na3am, anzilnee hunaak.
dialogue.english: Yes, at the back. Do you stop at Halbouni roundabout? Yes, let me off there.

pair.arabic: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
pair.transliteration: hal tadh-habu haadhihi al-7aafila ilaa al-Mazza?
pair.english: Does this bus go to Mazzeh?

lessons.culture: City buses and microbuses are cheap, busy and run on calling out your stop, so you tell the driver where to let you off. In the rush hour it is common to wait for the next one, which is almost always emptier.

exercises.prompt: You want to get off the bus. Ask the driver to let you off here.
exercises.tip: أَنْزِلْنِي is 'let me down' and هُنَا is 'here'.

exercises.prompt: The driver says: 'اِصْعَدْ'. Ask how much the fare is.
exercises.tip: كَمِ asks 'how much' before a noun.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'أَيْنَ _____ الْحَافِلَة؟' (Where's the bus stop?)
exercises.tip: مَوْقِف is a stopping place.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الْحَافِلَة مُزْدَحِمَة _____.' (The bus is very crowded.)
exercises.tip: جِدًّا means 'very' and comes after the word.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Is there an empty seat?'
exercises.tip: فَارِغ is 'empty'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What's the bus number to the university?'
exercises.tip: رَقْم is 'number'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks whether the bus goes to Mazzeh?
options: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
exercises.answer: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
accepted: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الْحَافِلَة إِلَى الْمَزَّة؟
هل تذهب هذه الحافلة إلى المزة؟
hal tadh-habu haadhihi al-7aafila ilaa al-Mazza?
هل تذهب هذه الحافلة الى المزة
exercises.tip: تَذْهَبُ is 'goes' for a feminine noun like الْحَافِلَة.

exercises.prompt: The bus is packed. Which sentence says so?
exercises.tip: مُزْدَحِمَة means 'crowded'.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'مِنْ فَضْلِكَ / هُنَا، / أَنْزِلْنِي'.
exercises.tip: Request, place, then the polite ending.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'رَقْمُ / مَا / الْجَامِعَة؟ / الْحَافِلَة / إِلَى'.
exercises.tip: مَا opens the question, the destination closes it.

phrases.arabic: هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَطْعَم جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟
phrases.transliteration: hal yoojadu mat3am jayyid fee al-mintaqa?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، أَيْنَ أَقْرَبُ مَصْرِف مِنْ هُنَا؟
dialogue.transliteration: law samahta, ayna aqrabu masrif min hunaa?
dialogue.english: Excuse me, where's the nearest bank from here?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: The bank is next to the station.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: And where is the station?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: In front of the park, near the hospital.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا. وَهَلْ يُوجَدُ مَطْعَم جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: shukran. wa hal yoojadu mat3am jayyid fee al-mintaqa?
dialogue.english: Thanks. And is there a good restaurant in the area?

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: Yes, after the school on the right.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: And where is the pharmacy? I need medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: Next to the mosque, near the market.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: And the church? My friend is waiting for me there.

dialogue.speaker: Passer-by
dialogue.english: At the end of the street, behind the school.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Thanks a lot, the area is lovely.

pair.english: Where's the nearest bank from here?

pair.arabic: هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَطْعَم جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟
pair.transliteration: hal yoojadu mat3am jayyid fee al-mintaqa?
pair.english: Is there a good restaurant in the area?

lessons.culture: When you ask for a place in Fusha, the answer gives a neighbour: next to, near, in front of, behind. Mosques, churches, schools and markets are the landmarks everyone shares.

exercises.prompt: You need money. Ask where the nearest bank is.
exercises.tip: أَقْرَبُ means 'nearest'.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'أَيْنَ الْمُسْتَشْفَى؟'. Say it is in front of the park.
exercises.tip: أَمَامَ means 'in front of'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الْمَصْرِف _____ الْمَحَطَّة.' (The bank is next to the station.)
exercises.tip: بِجَانِبِ means 'beside'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'هَلْ يُوجَدُ _____ جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟' (Is there a good restaurant in the area?)
exercises.tip: مَطْعَم is a place where you eat.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'the hospital'
exercises.tip: الْمُسْتَشْفَى comes from 'to seek a cure'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'Where is the pharmacy?'
exercises.tip: أَيْنَ is 'where' and goes first.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'the mosque'?
exercises.tip: الْمَسْجِد is the place of prostration.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'the park'?
exercises.tip: الْحَدِيقَة is a garden or park.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'مِنْ هُنَا؟ / أَيْنَ / مَصْرِف / أَقْرَبُ'.
exercises.tip: Where, nearest, what, from here.

exercises.prompt: Put the pieces in order: 'فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟ / هَلْ / مَطْعَم / يُوجَدُ / جَيِّد'.
exercises.answer: هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَطْعَم جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟
accepted: هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَطْعَم جَيِّد فِي الْمِنْطَقَة؟
هل يوجد مطعم جيد في المنطقة؟
هل يوجد مطعم جيد في المنطقة
hal yoojadu mat3am jayyid fee al-mintaqa?
exercises.tip: The adjective جَيِّد follows the noun it describes.

challenge.title: Finding your way
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation in Fusha in which you take a taxi to a place, ask a stranger for directions, ride a bus, and ask where a bank or restaurant is.
required_elements: a taxi destination with مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
directions using right, left or straight
a question about a bus or its stop
a place in town asked for by name
thanks and a reply to thanks

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: سَيَّارَة أُجْرَة! مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى بَابِ تُومَا.
dialogue.transliteration: sayyaarat ujra! min fadlika, ureedu adh-dhahaaba ilaa baabi Toomaa.
dialogue.english: Taxi! Please, I want to go to Bab Touma.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Go ahead, get in.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: How much is the fare to here?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: One thousand pounds. Is here fine?

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Yes, stop. Keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْتِ، أَيْنَ أَقْرَبُ مَصْرِف مِنْ هُنَا؟
dialogue.transliteration: law samahti, ayna aqrabu masrif min hunaa?
dialogue.english: Excuse me, where's the nearest bank from here?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: إِلَى الْأَمَامِ مُبَاشَرَة، ثُمَّ اِنْعَطِفْ يَسَارًا بَعْدَ الْمَسْجِد.
dialogue.transliteration: ilaa al-amaami mubaashara, thumma in3atif yasaaran ba3da al-masjid.
dialogue.english: Straight ahead, then turn left after the mosque.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Is it far or near?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: قَرِيب. وَهَلْ تُرِيدُ مَطْعَمًا جَيِّدًا أَيْضًا؟
dialogue.transliteration: qareeb. wa hal tureedu mat3aman jayyidan aydan?
dialogue.english: Near. Do you want a good restaurant too?

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Yes, and where's the bus stop?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: أَمَامَ الْمَحَطَّة. الْحَافِلَة تَأْتِي كُلَّ فَتْرَة قَصِيرَة.
dialogue.transliteration: amaama al-ma7atta. al-7aafila ta2tee kulla fatra qaseera.
dialogue.english: In front of the station. The bus comes every little while.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.english: Thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: You're welcome, no thanks needed.
